engine.kokoro.summary: Fast offline narration with dozens of built-in voices. Best default for long books.
engine.chatterbox.summary: Offline voice cloning — give it a short sample and it narrates in that voice.
engine.edge.summary: Free Microsoft cloud voices, 100+ languages. No install, needs internet.
engine.elevenlabs.summary: Premium cloud voices. Needs your own API key.
